chatzistergos_2017.note: non-parametric PDF-matrix daisy chain, 314 observers, 1739-2010. ASYMMETRIC errors: sigmaU -> gn_sd_hi, sigmaL -> gn_sd_lo, and gn_sd is left null rather than averaging them. -99 is the missing-value sentinel, so 266 of 272 years carry a value
chatzistergos_2017.reference: Chatzistergos, Usoskin, Kovaltsov, Krivova & Solanki 2017, A&A 602, A69 (CDS J/A+A/602/A69)

hoyt_schatten_1998.note: the original group sunspot number; reads blanket statements as daily observations (D7). Group counts, not 12.08-scaled (D24)

svalgaard_schatten_2016_backbone.note: the backbone series; A157 finds linear scaling amplifies strong cycles

usoskin_series.note: ADF-family series as carried by the 2017 MATLAB snapshot; the version string was not recorded there, so it is NOT asserted to be Usoskin et al. 2021
usoskin_series.reference: Usoskin et al., active-day-fraction family (exact version not recorded upstream)

vaquero.reference: Vaquero et al., as carried by the 2017 snapshot

velasco_herrera_2024.note: the V-ELSY/3.14 reconstruction, 1610-2022, in GROUP COUNTS. No uncertainty is published, so gn_sd is null. 401 of 413 years carry a value; NaN marks the rest
velasco_herrera_2024.reference: Velasco Herrera, Soon, Babynets, Murakozy, Tlatov, Nagovitsyn, Qiu, Svanda & Velasco Herrera 2024, Adv. Space Res. 73, 2788 (doi:10.1016/j.asr.2023.12.011)
velasco_herrera_2024.upstream: ScienceDirect supplement (closed access), PII S0273117723009651; supplied by the PI

velasco_herrera_2024_hoyt_update.note: H&S 1998 recomputed and extended to 2022. Published 12.08-scaled and DIVIDED BY 12.08 here so gn means group counts throughout (D24); it reproduces this folder's hoyt_schatten_1998 to 9e-4 over 1610-1995 and carries it 27 years further. -99 is the missing-value sentinel
velasco_herrera_2024_hoyt_update.reference: Velasco Herrera et al. 2024 (as above), updating Hoyt & Schatten 1998
velasco_herrera_2024_hoyt_update.upstream: ScienceDirect supplement (closed access), PII S0273117723009651; supplied by the PI

zolotova.reference: Zolotova & Ponyavin, as carried by the 2017 snapshot

units: gn is the mean daily group COUNT for every series; 12.08-scaled sources are divided by 12.08 on the way in (D24)
year_convention: as published per series: mid-year for three, integer for Vaquero and both Velasco Herrera series, exact fractional dates for Zolotova
